content: KMC3: two-stage minimizer/signature partitioning. Stage1 distributes super-mers (maximal runs sharing a signature=restricted canonical minimizer) into disk bins; Stage2 loads one bin at a time, splits to k-mers, sorts, aggregates exact counts, flushes. Signature constraints (no AAA/ACA prefix, no internal AA) avoid A-run giant bins, bounding peak memory to largest bin. KMC3 over KMC2: faster input parsing, memory-efficient signature->bin mapping, improved sort. ~constant RAM across k. Fit for rustkmer HIGH: reuses rayon+external-sort merge+memmap2; in-memory cache-sized buckets give speed, disk-backed gives memory ceiling; output stays .rkdb v2.
